svg.title: GitHub Actions CI/CD Pipeline — push to deploy
svg.desc: Full automation flow from git push to Docker Hub to VPS deployment

g.text: git add . && git commit -m "fix" && git push origin main
GitHub — repository receives push on main branch

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does checkout action do in GitHub Actions?')

sendPrompt('How to SSH into VPS from GitHub Actions?')
sendPrompt('docker stop and remove old container command')
sendPrompt('docker run command with env-file and port mapping')
sendPrompt('How to add Docker Hub credentials to GitHub Secrets?')
sendPrompt('How to create Docker Hub access token?')
sendPrompt('How to add SSH private key to GitHub Secrets?')
sendPrompt('What VPS host and username to use in GitHub Actions SSH?')
sendPrompt('What username does VPS SSH use by default?')
sendPrompt('What should VPS_DEPLOY_PATH be set to?')
